name: neruva-langchain
summary: Drop-in LangChain integration for Neruva agent memory substrate. v0.2.0 adds AUTO-PILOT: NeruvaAutoPilot (classify intent + reflect + extract via your LangChain LLM) and NeruvaAutoPilotCallback (BaseCallbackHandler). Plus NeruvaChatMessageHistory + NeruvaContextRetriever for memory + KG recall, NeruvaCodeGraph (5 code nav methods), NeruvaCognitive (13 cognitive primitives). Pattern-C: substrate stays $0/call.
